'''Dungal Lem''' was the third and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tor (star)|Tor]] in the [[Tobali system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Dungal Lem had twenty-four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and, along with [[Mash Shareo]], was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Tobali system]], except [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
